failure_patterns.pattern: rule_ignored: Agents returned a partial name or salient associated phrase instead of the requested referent: a lake name without its generic component, the dish instead of the season, or an epithet instead of the place.

rejected_edits.content: For an elliptical clue consisting only of a proper name or title, do not automatically repeat that name as the answer. Use the context to identify the relation the clue is likely testing and return the related entity when the intended slot is supported—for example, a ruler's name may cue the country they rule if the context explicitly establishes that relation. Do not infer a relation from mere association alone.
